subject: Contract meta.sleeperLoadedLeagueKey semantics
side_a: CLAUDE.md:165-166 'which league the sleeper block *would* be for, when sleeperDataReady: false (diagnostic only)'
side_b: server.py:3262 stamps it inside the sleeperDataReady=True overlay branch, guarded only by `if not sleeper_matches`
adjudication: The field's meaning changed to 'which league the base contract was built for' when the cross-league overlay landed; the doc still describes the pre-overlay meaning. On a valid dynasty_new payload it names dynasty_main.
evidence: curl -b cookies 'http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/data?view=compact&leagueKey=dynasty_new' -> meta {sleeperDataReady:true, sleeperLoadedLeagueKey:'dynasty_main'} with sleeper.leagueId=1320092771247222784

subject: 503-on-league-mismatch rule
side_a: CLAUDE.md:173-176 '/api/terminal, /api/trade/*, /api/angle/* — 503 whenever the loaded contract's leagueKey doesn't match the request'
side_b: GET /api/terminal?leagueKey=dynasty_new -> HTTP 200 with dynasty_new's own teams
adjudication: Holds for trade/* and angle/* (both 503 data_not_ready), not for terminal. The code is inconsistent with itself, and the doc groups all three.
evidence: curl -w '%{http_code}' -b cookies 'http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/terminal?leagueKey=dynasty_new' -> 200; POST /api/trade/finder and /api/angle/find with the same key -> 503

subject: Payload sizes
side_a: CLAUDE.md:806-807 full contract '~4 MB uncompressed'; delta '~1.25 MB uncompressed ... ~100 KB over the wire'
adjudication: All three absolute figures are ~3x low. The relative claim ('~70% smaller') is correct at 66.8%.

subject: The test that supposedly pins payload size
side_a: CLAUDE.md:809 'pins the delta shape, byte-size bounds'
side_b: tests/api/test_source_overrides.py:635-636 asserts delta_bytes < 55_000 on a synthetic fixture; its comment at :631 repeats 'delta is ~1.25MB vs ~4MB full'
adjudication: The bound is 71x smaller than the real delta. The test cannot detect the 3x drift in C-07 and its own comment propagates the wrong numbers.

subject: Why some rows carry a client-side ordinal
side_a: CLAUDE.md:679-681 'In practice that is players past the backend's OVERALL_RANK_LIMIT (800) — rows the backend deliberately left unranked'
side_b: Live contract: 1,092 rows, 740 ranked, MAX stamped rank = 740; the 239 unranked non-pick rows all have rankDerivedValue = null
adjudication: The 800 limit is never reached. The rows are unpriced, not over-limit. The doc's framing makes a pricing gap read as a deliberate depth cutoff.
evidence: python3 over /api/data payload: max(canonicalConsensusRank)=740; 239/239 unranked non-picks have rankDerivedValue None

subject: ADR-001..015 exist twice with unrelated subjects
side_a: docs/league-intelligence/DECISIONS.md: ADR-001..015 (ADR-008 = 'replacement levels use endogenous flex allocation'; ADR-015 = 'the TE alignment is now a measured basis conversion')
side_b: docs/consensus-edge/DECISIONS.md: ADR-001..025 (ADR-008 = 'the mispricing component earned its place'; ADR-015 = 'market movement is the right target')
adjudication: Genuinely ambiguous namespace. A third file, docs/roster-trade-intelligence/DECISIONS.md, contains a single ADR numbered 008 with no 001-007. CLAUDE.md:400-403 states the rule ('Always cite ADRs with their file') — and 36 of the 44 ADR citations in src/ + server.py break it.
evidence: grep -oE '^## ADR-[0-9]+' over the three DECISIONS.md files; grep -rnoE 'ADR-0[0-9]{2}' --include=*.py src/ server.py | 44 hits, 36 in the 001-015 collision range across 24 modules

subject: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md advertises a delta view that does not exist on that route
side_a: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md:101-105 'Next.js renders shell -> /api/data?view=delta -> build_rankings_delta_payload(...)'
side_b: GET /api/data?view=delta returns 11,953,535 bytes — byte-identical to no view param — payloadView null, and never calls build_rankings_delta_payload. The delta view lives on POST /api/rankings/overrides?view=delta (CLAUDE.md:807 has this right).
adjudication: ARCHITECTURE.md is wrong AND the route silently accepts an unknown view value instead of rejecting it, so the mistake is invisible at the call site. A developer following this doc ships 11.95 MB believing they asked for 3.92 MB.

subject: Does this platform have a database?
side_a: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md:9 'FastAPI (port 8000) -> SQLite'
side_b: docs/audits/decision-intelligence-audit-2026-08-04.md:~105 '**Database** | **None.** No SQL, no ORM, no migrations. JSON files + a user KV store.'
adjudication: ARCHITECTURE.md is right. Eight modules use sqlite3 with CREATE TABLE DDL — src/api/user_kv.py (which IS the 'user KV store' the audit excused), session_store.py, guest_passes.py, startup_validation.py, src/intel/ledger.py, src/intel/platform_ledger.py, src/consensus_edge/snapshot.py, src/sharp/roster_store.py. The audit then used 'no database' to declare the brief's SQL scope not applicable.
evidence: grep -rln sqlite3 --include=*.py src/ server.py -> 8 modules; user_kv.py:41 'CREATE TABLE user_state'

subject: Is the trade finder still offense-only?
side_a: docs/audits/decision-intelligence-audit-2026-08-04.md problem #4: 'The trade finder is still offense-only (the regression CLAUDE.md says was fixed) and its own IDP-blindness warning cannot fire.'
side_b: At HEAD: POST /api/trade/finder returns marketCoverage {'ktcSfTep':132,'ktc':18,'idpTradeCalc':150} and 40 trades containing DL x23, DB x26, LB x11
adjudication: The audit was RIGHT at its commit (9c5d972f, 2026-08-04 06:32 UTC) and is now REFUTED at HEAD. Commit a62af217 'Fix the arbitrage finder dropping every IDP asset' landed 2026-08-04 13:16 UTC — 6h44m later. This is the single clearest demonstration that the 531-finding registry is commit-scoped and must not be inherited wholesale.
evidence: git merge-base --is-ancestor a62af217 9c5d972f -> false; git log -1 --date=iso a62af217 -> 2026-08-04 13:16:03 +0000

subject: The 08-04 audit contradicts itself on its own headline count
side_a: line 30 'Largest root-cause category | **documentation mismatch (56)**'
side_b: line 86 '25 findings with root cause documentation mismatch, the single largest category'; line 712 '**single largest root-cause category (32 findings)**'
adjudication: Three different numbers for the same statistic in one document (56 / 25 / 32). The registry itself is the arbiter and was not re-counted here.

subject: Repository-state table in the 08-04 audit
side_a: 'server.py = 12,683 lines, 82 routes'; 'Next.js 15 — 39 pages, 30 bridge routes'; 'Testing | 378 pytest + 97 frontend files. **pytest not installed here** — suite not executable'
side_b: openapi.json -> 99 route operations; 41 pages; 36 bridge routes; next 16.2.12; evidence/test-results-summary.txt -> 6,278 pytest passed / 40 skipped / 0 failed

subject: AUDIT_PROTOCOL.md tells you to re-measure with a method it declares void
side_a: AUDIT_PROTOCOL.md:36-49 'A hand-rolled proxy was tried and **abandoned** ... evidence/page-probe-via-proxy-INVALID.json ... Any page-level observation not taken through request interception is void'
side_b: AUDIT_PROTOCOL.md:98-99 non-findings table: '404s on /api/* when a page is loaded from :3000 | Wrong topology — see the warning above. **Re-measure on :3001.**' and 'Only a finding if it reproduces on :3001.'
adjudication: The :3001 rows are leftovers from the abandoned method. A workstream following the table would produce void evidence. Should read 'via request interception'.

subject: AUDIT_PROTOCOL.md's consensus-edge non-finding names a route that does not exist
side_a: AUDIT_PROTOCOL.md:91 '/api/consensus-edge/* returns 503'
side_b: GET /api/consensus-edge/board -> 404 (no such route). The real routes are /players, /top, /player/{key}, /methodology, /health. /methodology returns **200** with the flag off.
adjudication: The 503 rule holds for 4 of 5 routes; /methodology is deliberately reachable while disabled (it explains the refusal). A workstream probing '/board' gets a 404 and could misreport it as a missing feature.
evidence: for p in board players top health methodology; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code} ' -b cookies http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/consensus-edge/$p; done -> 404 503 503 503 200

subject: AUDIT_PROTOCOL.md pins a HEAD the audit itself has moved past
side_a: AUDIT_PROTOCOL.md:50 'HEAD e96c06ef'
side_b: git rev-parse --short HEAD -> fe53d75c (three audit commits later)
adjudication: Harmless for code claims (the audit commits touch only docs/master-site-audit/) but it means 'at HEAD' in one shard and another can differ. Cite SHAs explicitly.
evidence: git log --oneline e96c06ef..HEAD -> 4 commits, all under docs/master-site-audit/

subject: math audit filename disagrees with its own title
side_a: docs/audits/math-formula-audit-2026-07-30.md (filename)
side_b: line 1: '# Sitewide math and formula audit — 2026-08-04'

subject: UNIMPLEMENTED_BACKLOG.md declares itself superseded but stays in the root
side_a: UNIMPLEMENTED_BACKLOG.md:24-40 'Read this first: much of this file is already superseded ... The remaining entries were not re-verified one by one — treat them with the same suspicion.'
side_b: The file is 41,601 bytes in the repo root, adjacent to CLAUDE.md and README.md, with no ARCHIVED marker in its filename or location
adjudication: A document whose own header says do-not-trust-me should not sit in the root alongside the authority. Archive it or delete it; keeping it costs a reader the time to discover it is worthless.

subject: docs/status/ describes a 2026-03 system that no longer exists
side_a: 22 files live in docs/status/. Exactly ONE carries a STALE banner (promotion-readiness.md) and one carries 'superseded' (workstream-inventory.md). Twenty carry no staleness marker at all.
side_b: 20 of the 22 have a latest internal date of 2026-04-28 or earlier — three to four months before HEAD — and describe a pipeline that predates the Final Framework transition (docs/architecture/final-framework-transition.md, itself banner-marked 'superseded', 2026-04-20).
adjudication: The two markers imply the other twenty are current. They are not. See evidence/W25/supersession-list.csv for a per-file disposition.
evidence: for f in docs/status/*.md; do grep -ohE 'STALE|superseded' $f; grep -ohE '20[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}' $f | sort | tail -1; done (git mtimes are useless — history was squashed 2026-08-03)

subject: W25's own brief mis-states the docs/status/ inventory
side_a: Prompt: '~139 docs exist; 22 in docs/status/ date to 2026-03-14 and three carry STALE banners; UNIMPLEMENTED_BACKLOG.md declares ITSELF superseded'
side_b: Measured: 144 tracked .md outside node_modules/frontend/master-site-audit; docs/status/ holds 22 files of which only THREE date to 2026-03-14 and only ONE carries a STALE banner. The UNIMPLEMENTED_BACKLOG.md half is exactly right.
adjudication: Directionally correct, numerically off. Recorded here because the brief asked for 'any requirement in the audit brief that conflicts with a repo decision' and because a finding built on the brief's numbers rather than re-measured ones would inherit the error.
evidence: git ls-files '*.md' | grep -v node_modules | grep -v ^frontend/ | grep -v ^docs/master-site-audit/ | wc -l -> 144; per-file scan of docs/status/
